en: Black‑and‑white image showing a landscaped garden with flowerbeds, trimmed shrubs, a central stone planter, and curved walking paths in the foreground. A person is seated on a bench at the right. Behind the garden stand two sizable villa‑style buildings on a gentle slope, surrounded by dense forest. One building has a sign on its upper facade and balconies; the other, slightly to the right, has a more modest size with a sign on the gable wall. The scene evokes a spa or pension complex in a wooded hillside setting.
